parole.significato: Refers to a hypothetical or hoped-for possibility that is not entirely certain: perhaps, maybe
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *ehkä, cognate with Finnish ehkä, Votic ehči, Karelian ehki. Possibly derived from the negative verb stem *e-, whence modern Estonian ei, or from an identical Proto-Uralic stem meaning 'this', from which et. From Proto-Finnic *mëtu, from either Proto-Germanic *meduz or Proto-Balto-Slavic *medú. Cognate to Votic mõtu (“mead, beer”) and dialectal Finnish metu (“nectar, honey, juice”).
From either Proto-Balto-Slavic *kranta or Proto-Norse [script needed] (*stranđa). Compare German Strand (“beach”), Lithuanian krantas (“beach, shore”) and Finnish ranta (“shore, beach, bank”).
